# Data-science members: RNUM, RDATAFRAME, RPLOT

Every method and property name the components answer, with its aliases. There is one implementation (`rapidr_value::datascience`), so every name works the same in native builds, interpreted programs and the browser; only drawing a chart is each runtime's own (a PNG made with plotters on the desktop, an HTML canvas on the web). Names are not case-sensitive, and a method that returns a value can be read like a property (`PRINT arr.Sum`), as a property can be read like a method (`PRINT arr.Shape`). How to use them: [Data science](../data-science.md).
